content.short: Plug Wallet is a non-custodial multi-chain wallet covering Internet Computer, Bitcoin and EVM chains.
content.description: Plug Wallet began as the main wallet for the Internet Computer and now also handles Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and other networks. Supporting a non-EVM chain like ICP alongside EVM ones requires handling two quite different account models in one interface.
content.meta: Self-custody spanning Internet Computer, Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana in one interface.
content.pageTitle: Plug Wallet - Web3 Wallets - Lancers Web3 Explorer
